item.title: REFORMS: Oil output has grown by 600,000bpd since PIA — NNPC
item.description: By Obas Esiedesa, Abuja Nigeria’s crude oil production has increased by 600,000 barrels per day (bpd), from about 1.2 million bpd to 1.8 million bpd, following the implementation of the Petroleum Industry Act (PIA) and reforms in the oil and gas sector, the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) has said. Group Chief Executive Officer of NNPC Limited, Mr Bashir Bayo Ojulari, disclosed this yesterday at the 2026 Abu Dhabi International Petroleum Exhibition and Conference (ADIPEC) in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Speaking at an Energy Talk titled, “Nigeria’s Reform Agenda: Competing for Energy Capital,” Ojulari attributed the production increase to the implementation of the PIA 2021, improved investment climate, better investment decisions and stronger collaboration between NNPC and its partners. He said the company was working towards achieving Nigeria’s two million bpd production ambition by 2027 through improved maintenance of existing infrastructure, protection of base production, increased output from producing assets and execution of new projects. “The figure of 1.8 million barrels per day is a stage in a journey towards our objective. We are concentrating on the basics, which are maintaining our infrastructure, protecting base operations and executing the projects that will take production higher,” he said. On domestic energy supply, the NNPC boss said the removal of petrol subsidy had been accompanied by a major compressed natural gas (CNG) programme, with more than 400 conversion centres established across the country. He added that over 1,000 trucks used in transporting petroleum products had also been converted to run on CNG. Ojulari disclosed that the Obiafu-Obrikom-Oben (OB3) gas pipeline was completed in August 2026, while the Ajaokuta-Kaduna-Kano (AKK) pipeline was expected to deliver gas to Abuja before the end of the year to support power generation, data centres and industrial hubs. On gas development, he said NNPC was targeting national production of 10 billion standard cubic feet per day (Bscf/d) by 2027 and 12 Bscf/d by 2030, supported by the development of domestic and international markets. He also said the countries involved in the Nigeria-Morocco Gas Pipeline had aligned and executed the necessary agreements, while Nigeria, Algeria and Niger had reached alignment on the development of the Trans-Saharan Gas Pipeline. On investment, Ojulari cited major projects, including TotalEnergies’ Ubeta, Shell’s Bonga South-West and Eni’s Zabazaba developments, noting that commercial agreements covering about $20 billion in investments had been concluded. He added that NNPC was building new relationships with international partners, including the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) and Chinese investors in Nigeria’s refineries, while working with global oilfield service companies to expand capacity in the country. item.content:encoded: By Obas Esiedesa, Abuja Nigeria’s crude oil production has increased by 600,000 barrels per day (bpd), from about 1.2 million bpd to 1.8 million bpd, following the implementation of the Petroleum Industry Act (PIA) and reforms in the oil and gas sector, the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) has said. Speaking at an Energy Talk titled, “Nigeria’s Reform Agenda: Competing for Energy Capital,” Ojulari attributed the production increase to the implementation of the PIA 2021, improved investment climate, better investment decisions and stronger collaboration between NNPC and its partners. He said the company was working towards achieving Nigeria’s two million bpd production ambition by 2027 through improved maintenance of existing infrastructure, protection of base production, increased output from producing assets and execution of new projects. “The figure of 1.8 million barrels per day is a stage in a journey towards our objective. We are concentrating on the basics, which are maintaining our infrastructure, protecting base operations and executing the projects that will take production higher,” he said. On domestic energy supply, the NNPC boss said the removal of petrol subsidy had been accompanied by a major compressed natural gas (CNG) programme, with more than 400 conversion centres established across the country. He added that over 1,000 trucks used in transporting petroleum products had also been converted to run on CNG. Ojulari disclosed that the Obiafu-Obrikom-Oben (OB3) gas pipeline was completed in August 2026, while the Ajaokuta-Kaduna-Kano (AKK) pipeline was expected to deliver gas to Abuja before the end of the year to support power generation, data centres and industrial hubs. On gas development, he said NNPC was targeting national production of 10 billion standard cubic feet per day (Bscf/d) by 2027 and 12 Bscf/d by 2030, supported by the development of domestic and international markets. He also said the countries involved in the Nigeria-Morocco Gas Pipeline had aligned and executed the necessary agreements, while Nigeria, Algeria and Niger had reached alignment on the development of the Trans-Saharan Gas Pipeline. On investment, Ojulari cited major projects, including TotalEnergies’ Ubeta, Shell’s Bonga South-West and Eni’s Zabazaba developments, noting that commercial agreements covering about $20 billion in investments had been concluded. He added that NNPC was building new relationships with international partners, including the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) and Chinese investors in Nigeria’s refineries, while working with global oilfield service companies to expand capacity in the country. According to him, a baseline assessment of NNPC’s asset base and infrastructure has also provided management with a clearer understanding of the company’s portfolio, its strengths and areas requiring improvement. He said the board and management were committed to delivering on the mandate given to the company by President Bola Tinubu. “Our track record will be judged by what is done and not by what is said,” he stated. Ojulari reaffirmed NNPC’s commitment to transparency and execution excellence, citing two consecutive earnings calls organised by the company as part of efforts to strengthen accountability. item.title: Kentucky Gets Major Boost From Iowa State Transfer in Season Debut
item.description: LEXINGTON, KENTUCKY - NOVEMBER 03: Milan Momcilovic #22 of the Kentucky Wildcats reacts during the second half against the Manhattan Jaspers at Rupp Arena on November 03, 2026 in Lexington, Kentucky. (Photo by Justin Casterline/Getty Images) Getty LEXINGTON, KENTUCKY - NOVEMBER 03: Milan Momcilovic #22 of the Kentucky Wildcats takes a shot over Ben Tweedy #6 of the Manhattan Jaspers during the second half at Rupp Arena on November 03, 2026 in Lexington, Kentucky. (Photo by Justin Casterline/Getty Images) Getty KANSAS CITY, MISSOURI - MARCH 13: forward Milan Momcilovic #22 of the Iowa State Cyclones shoots against the Arizona Wildcats in the first half during the semifinals of the Big 12 Tournament at T-Mobile Center on March 13, 2026 in Kansas City, Missouri. (Photo by Ed Zurga/Getty Images) Getty LEXINGTON, KENTUCKY - NOVEMBER 03: Milan Momcilovic #22 of the Kentucky Wildcats reacts after making a shot in front of Isaac Johnson #2 of the Manhattan Jaspers during the second half at Rupp Arena on November 03, 2026 in Lexington, Kentucky. (Photo by Justin Casterline/Getty Images) Getty Kentucky forward Milan Momcilovic impressed in his first game as a Wildcat. Momcilovic scored a game-high 24 points in Kentucky’s 85-57 win over Manhattan. The Iowa State transfer knocked down six of his nine three-point attempts. The Kentucky Forward was Efficient Getty LEXINGTON, KENTUCKY – NOVEMBER 03: Milan Momcilovic #22 of the Kentucky Wildcats takes a shot over Ben Tweedy #6 of the Manhattan Jaspers during the second half at Rupp Arena on November 03, 2026 in Lexington, Kentucky. (Photo by Justin Casterline/Getty Images) Momcilovic made eight of his 12 shot attempts from the field and shot 66.7% from three. This allowed him to get a very efficient 24 points in 28 minutes of playing time. He looked very confident out there and worked perfectly for this Wildcat offense. Momcilovic didn’t get his first points until 7:21 left in the first half, when he knocked down a three. After he made that three, he was on fire, letting the game come to him. All it took for him to get going was to see the ball go through once, and he started hitting everything. Momcilovic’s Past Getty KANSAS CITY, MISSOURI – MARCH 13: forward Milan Momcilovic #22 of the Iowa State Cyclones shoots against the Arizona Wildcats in the first half during the semifinals of the Big 12 Tournament at T-Mobile Center on March 13, 2026 in Kansas City, Missouri. (Photo by Ed Zurga/Getty Images) At Iowa State, Momcilovic averaged 16.9 points and shot 48.7% from three, which is unbelievably good. That alone made him a big target for Kentucky to go out and try to get him. A good three-point shooter is what the Wildcats have needed, but instead they got a great three-point shooter. Momcilovic also earned second-team All-Big 12 honors. Kentucky brought him in so he could provide elite three-point shooting, and in one game, it looks like it’s already paying off. He did what the Wildcats’ offense needed him to do

(Photo by Patrick McDermott/Getty Images) Getty The Chicago Bulls could have a decision to make involving one of their offseason additions. According to NBA insider Jake Fischer, Chicago is looking to field offers for Norman Powell ahead of the trade deadline. The report puts a scorer into a conversation about how the Bulls intend to build their future. For fans, the development raises a question beyond whether Powell can help another team. Chicago added him to strengthen its offense and provide experience around younger players. Listening to offers would require weighing those benefits against whatever another organization might offer. Jake Fischer Reports Bulls’ Interest in Norman Powell Offers Fischer’s reported update concerns Chicago’s willingness to consider offers. It does not establish that a trade has been agreed upon or identify a confirmed destination. That distinction matters because availability alone does not determine a player’s return. Other teams must evaluate fit, salary and the assets they would need to surrender. Chicago would then have to decide whether the package improves its position enough to justify losing Powell. Powell joined the Bulls after earning his first All-Star selection with Miami last season. His agreement includes a team option for the second season, giving Chicago a future decision beyond the trade market. That structure leaves the organization multiple paths to consider. According to NBA insider Jake Fischer, Chicago is looking to field offers for Norman Powell ahead of the trade deadline. The report puts a scorer into a conversation about how the Bulls intend to build their future. For fans, the development raises a question beyond whether Powell can help another team. Chicago added him to strengthen its offense and provide experience around younger players. Listening to offers would require weighing those benefits against whatever another organization might offer. Jake Fischer Reports Bulls’ Interest in Norman Powell Offers Fischer’s reported update concerns Chicago’s willingness to consider offers. It does not establish that a trade has been agreed upon or identify a confirmed destination. That distinction matters because availability alone does not determine a player’s return. Other teams must evaluate fit, salary and the assets they would need to surrender. Chicago would then have to decide whether the package improves its position enough to justify losing Powell. Powell joined the Bulls after earning his first All-Star selection with Miami last season. His agreement includes a team option for the second season, giving Chicago a future decision beyond the trade market. That structure leaves the organization multiple paths to consider. (Photo by Patrick McDermott/Getty Images) The basketball appeal for a potential buyer is straightforward. Additional perimeter scoring can help a team when its primary options face extra defensive attention. Powell’s experience could make him attractive to an organization seeking immediate offensive support rather than another developmental project. What a Powell Trade Could Mean for Chicago For the Bulls, however, moving a veteran should involve more than making room. Younger players benefit from opportunities, but they also need functional lineups and experienced teammates. Chicago must assess whether a deal supplies value without making development harder elsewhere. Keeping Powell carries its own argument. A reliable scoring presence can reduce the pressure on less experienced players and help an offense survive difficult stretches. Those contributions deserve consideration alongside draft picks or younger players that might appear in hypothetical offers. The decision ultimately comes down to what becomes available. A strong proposal could give Chicago a reason to adjust its plans. A disappointing market could make retaining Powell the more sensible choice. Fischer’s report makes Powell a name to monitor, not a player already departing. Bulls fans should watch the offers and reporting before judging the outcome. item.title: Lions Sign Ex-Cardinals Draft Pick After Jack Campbell Injury
item.description: Photo by Christian Petersen/Getty Images Getty Jack Campbell of the Detroit Lions Getty The Detroit Lions have acted quickly in finding their replacement options for the injured Jack Campbell. First, the team signed K.J. Britt to their active roster. Their second move was signing linebacker Owen Pappoe to their practice squad. With Pappoe in the mix, it looks like the Lions have made their moves to replace Campbell and rookie Jimmy Rolder in the short term. Detroit Lions Sign Owen Pappoe to Practice Squad in Response to Jack Campbell Injury Getty Jack Campbell of the Detroit Lions The team lost two players from their active roster and signed Britt and Pappoe. Britt is on the active roster, as they signed him from the New England Patriots practice squad. However, Pappoe will join Joe Bachie on the practice squad with the Lions. Bachie is the likely name to get called up, as he has been with the team throughout the year, and he can provide help on special teams. With Britt up and Bachie expected to be called up, they have two replacements on the roster. Then, Pappoe would step in and replace Bachie. Detroit is likely going to try to start Malcolm Rodriguez next to Derrick Barnes as their starter. Trevor Nowaske will slide in as the third linebacker. Then, Amen Ogbongbemiga, Britt, and Bachie will serve as the backups. All three have special teams value, giving them a reason to be active. Still, the moves likely do not stop them from making a bigger move at linebacker before the trade deadline. However, with the injury happening on Sunday, this is a quick pivot. Lions Add Depth at LB Before Week 9 Pappoe is a fifth-round pick by the Arizona Cardinals . Pappoe has been a notable special teams contributor for his first three NFL seasons. Despite just two starts in three seasons, he was active for every game. Pappoe has 960 career special teams snaps, with 16 coming this season. He also has 341 snaps in his NFL career. He played 114 snaps as a rookie, 131 the following season, and then only 96 in 2025. He did not see the field on defense in 2026. He started the year on the Tennessee Titans . He started on their practice squad, but was also called up for special teams duties in Week 2. The Titans released him on October 6. After being a free agent for nearly a month, he finally caught on with the Lions’ practice squad. His experience on special teams will make him a competitive option for Bachie as the sixth linebacker. The Lions take on the Miami Dolphins in Week 9. This article was originally published on HEAVY The post Lions Sign Ex-Cardinals Draft Pick After Jack Campbell Injury appeared first on HEAVY .

item.title: US Midterms: Democrats take control of US Congress as voters reject Trump’s Republicans
item.description: Democrats have taken control of both chambers of the United States Congress in the November 3, 2026, midterm elections, dealing a major political setback to President Donald Trump and his Republican Party. The victory marks a significant shift in the balance of power in Washington, giving Democrats control of the House of Representatives and the Senate for the remaining two years of Trump’s presidency. According to the BBC, Democrats had secured a majority in the House of Representatives as of Wednesday, although vote counting was continuing in several states. The figures available at the time of filing this report showed Democrats with 194 seats in the House against 115 for Republicans, while in the Senate, Democrats had secured 52 seats against 40 for Republicans. The Democratic Party also recorded major upsets in several closely contested Senate races, winning Republican-held seats in Texas, South Carolina, North Carolina and Ohio, while retaining Democratic seats in Georgia and New Hampshire. In Texas, Democrat James Talarico defeated Republican Ken Paxton, becoming the first Democrat to win a Senate seat in the state since 1988. In South Carolina, Democrat Annie Andrews defeated Republican Darline Graham, becoming the first woman elected to the US Senate from the state and the first Democrat to win a Senate seat there in more than two decades. Democrat Roy Cooper also defeated Republican Michael Whatley in North Carolina, while Sherrod Brown defeated Republican incumbent Jon Husted to win the Ohio Senate race. The results represent a major reversal of political fortunes for Republicans, whose control of Congress had given Trump’s administration considerable legislative advantage. The midterm elections, held on Tuesday, November 3, determine the composition of the United States Congress, comprising the 435-member House of Representatives and the 100-member Senate. All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats were contested. The Democratic takeover is expected to intensify congressional scrutiny of Trump’s administration, with the opposition party gaining control of key committees and greater powers to investigate government policies and decisions. The BBC reported that Democratic control of the House could significantly constrain what Trump could achieve during the remaining two years of his presidency. Democrats could launch investigations into the president and his family, as well as controversial decisions and policies of his administration. Reacting to the Republican losses, Trump sought to distance himself from the outcome, arguing that his absence from the ballot contributed to the party’s poor performance. “I wasn’t on the Ballot and if I was, we would have won IN A LANDSLIDE!” he wrote on his Truth Social platform. However, in an interview with The New York Times published later, Trump said he was prepared to accept the election results and work with Democrats. “We’ll, you know, look forward to working with them. item.content:encoded: Democrats have taken control of both chambers of the United States Congress in the November 3, 2026, midterm elections, dealing a major political setback to President Donald Trump and his Republican Party. The victory marks a significant shift in the balance of power in Washington, giving Democrats control of the House of Representatives and the Senate for the remaining two years of Trump’s presidency. According to the BBC, Democrats had secured a majority in the House of Representatives as of Wednesday, although vote counting was continuing in several states. The figures available at the time of filing this report showed Democrats with 194 seats in the House against 115 for Republicans, while in the Senate, Democrats had secured 52 seats against 40 for Republicans. The Democratic Party also recorded major upsets in several closely contested Senate races, winning Republican-held seats in Texas, South Carolina, North Carolina and Ohio, while retaining Democratic seats in Georgia and New Hampshire. In Texas, Democrat James Talarico defeated Republican Ken Paxton, becoming the first Democrat to win a Senate seat in the state since 1988. In South Carolina, Democrat Annie Andrews defeated Republican Darline Graham, becoming the first woman elected to the US Senate from the state and the first Democrat to win a Senate seat there in more than two decades. Democrat Roy Cooper also defeated Republican Michael Whatley in North Carolina, while Sherrod Brown defeated Republican incumbent Jon Husted to win the Ohio Senate race. The results represent a major reversal of political fortunes for Republicans, whose control of Congress had given Trump’s administration considerable legislative advantage. The midterm elections, held on Tuesday, November 3, determine the composition of the United States Congress, comprising the 435-member House of Representatives and the 100-member Senate. All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats were contested. The Democratic takeover is expected to intensify congressional scrutiny of Trump’s administration, with the opposition party gaining control of key committees and greater powers to investigate government policies and decisions. The BBC reported that Democratic control of the House could significantly constrain what Trump could achieve during the remaining two years of his presidency. Democrats could launch investigations into the president and his family, as well as controversial decisions and policies of his administration. Reacting to the Republican losses, Trump sought to distance himself from the outcome, arguing that his absence from the ballot contributed to the party’s poor performance. “I wasn’t on the Ballot and if I was, we would have won IN A LANDSLIDE!” he wrote on his Truth Social platform. However, in an interview with The New York Times published later, Trump said he was prepared to accept the election results and work with Democrats. “We’ll, you know, look forward to working with them. We’ll probably work something out,” he said. The Associated Press reported that Trump had backed several Republican candidates who lost their races, including Paxton in Texas and Graham in South Carolina. The midterm elections are traditionally regarded as a referendum on the performance of the sitting president, with voters determining whether the governing party retains control of Congress or faces an opposition majority. The Democratic victories mean Trump will have to contend with an opposition-controlled Congress during the final two years of his second term, setting the stage for possible legislative confrontations and increased oversight of his administration. item.title: NESG: Economic growth must deliver jobs, higher incomes
item.description: By Babajide Komolafe Chairman of the Nigerian Economic Summit Group (NESG), Mr. Omoboyede Olusanya, has called for a shift from measuring Nigeria’s economic progress by headline growth figures to delivering tangible improvements in jobs, incomes, productivity and living standards. Olusanya made the call at the closing of the 32nd Nigerian Economic Summit (NES#32) in Abuja, saying: “Growth that delivers is growth whose impact is strongly felt. “It means farmers earn more because their productivity has improved; manufacturers produce at lower cost; graduates find decent jobs; businesses access affordable financing; and children receive the nutrition and healthcare they need to thrive.” Introducing “Growth that Delivers” as the guiding principle of his tenure as NESG chairman, he said: “While recent reforms have helped restore macroeconomic stability, stability is only the starting point. “Bridging the distance between macroeconomic stability and accelerated growth, and between accelerated growth and improved lives and livelihoods, is the task before us all.” Outlining his priorities, Olusanya pledged to make accountability a central feature of the organisation’s engagement with government and other stakeholders. “We will ensure that every priority commitment from this Summit has a designated owner, a timeline and measurable indicators of success, building on the NES Accountability Framework and publishing progress ahead of NES#33,” he stated. On evidence-driven policy, he said: “We will strengthen our research and policy intelligence to produce rigorous, practical and costed recommendations linked to the National Development Plan 2026–2030.” On investment mobilisation, he pledged that the NESG would work with government, financial institutions and development partners to “turn policy ideas into bankable projects and mobilise capital into agriculture, manufacturing, infrastructure, technology, entrepreneurship and skills.” He also promised to expand economic opportunities across all regions and states, with greater attention to micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) and the informal economy. On institutional sustainability, he said the NESG would broaden its membership, increase the participation of women and young people, protect its independence and strengthen its sustainability for future generations. Calling for collective action, Olusanya urged governments at all levels to “sustain and improve reforms, reduce the costs of power, logistics and doing business, and maintain predictable policies backed by clear, measurable commitments.” He challenged private-sector leaders to “invest, innovate, develop workforce skills, pay fairly and create productive jobs.” He also urged young Nigerians to “build enterprises, acquire relevant skills and hold institutions accountable,” while calling on civil society to monitor commitments and amplify the voices of underserved communities. item.title: Ex-Giants QB Russell Wilson Interviewed for FBS Head Coaching Job
item.description: New York Giants QB Russell Wilson. Getty Former New York Giants quarterback Russell Wilson could be headed for a major career shift less than one year after the end of his NFL career. “Former Super Bowl champion quarterback Russell Wilson interviewed Tuesday for the head coaching job at NC State, ” ESPN’s Adam Schefter wrote on Tuesday night. “Wilson, 38, joins Philip Rivers as former NC State and NFL quarterbacks who are now prominent candidates for the Wolfpack job. NC State fired Dave Doeren as head coach on Oct. 24. Wilson played at NC State from 2008 to 2010 before transferring to Wisconsin in 2011. After being taken by Seattle in the third round of the 2012 NFL draft, he went on to play 14 seasons in the NFL, leading the Seahawks to their first Super Bowl championship in the 2013 season.” Wilson, a 10-time NFL All-Pro, retired in June after spending one season with the Giants in 2025 and has been working for CBS Sports as an analyst this fall. “Interesting that Russell Wilson and Philip Rivers are contenders,” NFL reporter Ed Werder wrote on his official X account on Tuesday. Wilson spent his first 10 seasons with the Seattle Seahawks , where he won one Super Bowl and played in another before a blockbuster trade to the Broncos before the 2022 season. He lasted 2 seasons in Denver before spending one season each with the Pittsburgh Steelers and Giants . Broncos’ Wilson Trade One of NFL’s All-Time Worst Bleacher Report’s Kristopher Knox called the Broncos’ trade with the Seahawks for Wilson “Worst NFL Trade of the Last 10 Years” for the franchise. By releasing Wilson in April 2024, the Broncos were forced to take an NFL-record $85 million dead cap hit spread across the 2024 and 2025 seasons. “The Denver Broncos’ ill-fated 2022 trade for Russell Wilson has largely been overshadowed by the disastrous deal Cleveland made for Deshaun Watson in the same offseason,” Knox wrote. “However, that doesn’t mean that Denver’s deal was a good one. In fact, the Wilson trade might be considered the worst of the last decade if not for the Watson debacle. The Broncos coughed up two first-round picks, two second-round picks, a fifth-round pick, quarterback Drew Lock , defensive lineman Shelby Harris and tight end Noah Fant to acquire Wilson and a fourth-round pick. The Broncos then signed Wilson to an extension worth $242.6 million over five years with $161 million guaranteed.” Russell Wilson, Sean Payton Butted Heads in 2023 The writing was on the wall for Wilson once Nathaniel Hackett was fired after one season as Denver’s head coach in 2022 and replaced with former New Orleans Saints head coach and Super Bowl champion Sean Payton. Wilson rejuvenated his career somewhat in 2024 with the Pittsburgh Steelers on a 1-year, $1.2 million contract. After missing the first 6 games of the season due to injury — Justin Fields started in his place — Wilson returned to go 6-5 for the Steelers, who made the AFC Playoffs before losing to the Baltimore Ravens in the AFC Wild Card Round, with Wilson going 20-of-29 passing for 270 yards, two touchdowns, and zero interceptions. Wilson signed a 1-year, $10.5 million contract with the New York Giants on March 27 — just one month before they selected Ole Miss quarterback Jaxson Dart in the first round of the 2025 NFL draft . item.title: ‘I Need to Do Better,’ ‘Maybe I Should Chill’ — Caitlin Clark Makes Honest Admission About Major Source of Criticism
item.description: Caitlin Clark discusses trash talk, referees and the competitive habit she believes she needs to manage better. Caitlin Clark has never been shy about showing emotion on the court, but the Indiana Fever star says one part of her competitive reputation may be overstated. During Tuesday’s special episode of Kylie Kelce’s “Not Gonna Lie” podcast, she was asked about her on-court behavior, leading to a candid admission about one tendency she knows she needs to work on. Caitlin Clark Admits Referees Get More of Her Attention Than Opponents Kelce asked whether the former No. 1 pick was an underrated trash talker, and she disagreed . “See, people always think that I’m a trash talker. I don’t even think I really am,” Clark said. She explained that her exchanges with opponents are usually playful, recalling a moment against Breanna Stewart and the New York Liberty during the 2025 season: “There was a clip that went viral last year when we played the Liberty and I made a 3 over Stewie. And me and Stewie just both started laughing, ’cause it was funny.” The Fever guard then brought up another part of her on-court behavior: “I don’t really trash talk like that, honestly. I mean, if somebody says something to me, I’ll probably go back. Honestly, the people I talk to the most is the refs, which I need to do better at. Maybe I should chill on that a little bit.” Kelce later asked if any particular player stood out as a trash talker. She said opponents rarely direct much trash talk her way. “People don’t really talk trash to me,” Clark said, drawing a “What a flex” from Kelce. The 2024 WNBA Rookie of the Year added that she enjoys those exchanges when they happen. “I want you to say something to me,” Clark said. “And I try to honestly do my best to just act like I can’t hear. I love that. I think that’s funny.” Her interactions with officials drew attention throughout the 2026 season, including an August technical foul that nearly resulted in a suspension. During Indiana’s 90-86 win over the Chicago Sky on Aug. 8, Natasha Cloud bumped Clark as she drove along the baseline. The Fever floor general passed the ball and went out of bounds, where her momentum carried her into an official. SEE ALSO: ‘A Little Silly In My Opinion’ — Caitlin Clark Reveals 1 Change She Would Make to WNBA Playoffs After Fever’s First-Round Exit The contact initially resulted in her eighth technical foul of the season. Fever coach Stephanie White also received one for arguing the call. Indiana appealed immediately, and the WNBA rescinded the technical, ESPN’s Kareem Copeland reported. The decision spared Clark a suspension that would have kept her out of the Fever’s Aug. 11 home game against the Liberty. It was the first time that season the Fever had successfully appealed a technical foul assessed to Clark. SEE ALSO: ‘A Little Silly In My Opinion’ — Caitlin Clark Reveals 1 Change She Would Make to WNBA Playoffs After Fever’s First-Round Exit The contact initially resulted in her eighth technical foul of the season. Fever coach Stephanie White also received one for arguing the call. Indiana appealed immediately, and the WNBA rescinded the technical, ESPN’s Kareem Copeland reported. The decision spared Clark a suspension that would have kept her out of the Fever’s Aug. 11 home game against the Liberty. It was the first time that season the Fever had successfully appealed a technical foul assessed to Clark. Even with the eighth rescinded, her seven technicals were tied for the most in the WNBA at that point. The three-time All-Star picked up her second technical foul of the playoffs in her final game on Oct. 1. She and Las Vegas Aces forward Brianna Turner were assessed double technical fouls in the first quarter of Game 3 en route to Indiana’s season-ending 94-83 road loss. This article originally appeared on Pro Football Network .

item.title: ‘I Really Hope He Doesn’t Get Fined For This’ — Packers Fans Beyond Amused as Jordan Love And His Wife Troll NFL Refs After Lions Controversy
item.description: ‘I Really Hope He Doesn’t Get Fined For This’ — NFL Fans Beyond Amused as Packers Star Jordan Love And His Wife Troll Refs After Lions Controversy Green Bay Packers quarterback Jordan Love and his wife, Ronika Stone Love, found a hilarious way to express their frustration with NFL officiating this Halloween. The couple’s costume quickly went viral, with fans fully embracing their not-so-subtle dig at officials following Green Bay’s controversial loss to the Detroit Lions in Week 7. Love and Ronika dressed up as blind NFL referees, complete with the zebra-striped shirts, dark sunglasses, and white canes. Jordan Love and His Wife’s Halloween Costumes Get Fans Talking The joke went viral after Ronika posted a clip on TikTok captioned “I’m joking, I’m joking.” In the video , the couple can be seen blindly stumbling around, tapping their white canes, and launching yellow penalty flags into the air for no apparent reason. Fans quickly filled the comments section, with many finding the joke hilarious while others worried the quarterback could face a fine from the NFL. One fan joked, “You’re gonna get us fined.” Another supporter jokingly remarked, “Chill, Ronika, we play away this weekend, the refs might see this.” Others shared similar concerns, with one commenter saying, “I can smell the fine coming,” while another added, “I really hope he doesn’t get fined for this.” One fan even offered to cover the cost, saying , “I’ll pay the fine” Love’s wife also joined the fun in the comments, responding to the growing attention with a simple message intended to cover all bases: “We’re Footlocker employees.” PREDICT THE NFL SEASON: PFN’s Free NFL Playoff Predictor Why the Halloween Costume Went Viral The couple’s costume was more than just a random Halloween gag, of course. It came after Green Bay suffered a frustrating 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions in Week 7, with several officiating decisions becoming a major talking point. Referee Alex Moore’s crew called eight penalties against the Packers for 81 yards, with some decisions drawing criticism from fans and analysts. The biggest talking point was the roughing-the-passer calls against defensive linemen Brenton Cox Jr. and Karl Brooks. SET YOUR LINEUPS: PFN’s Free Fantasy Start/Sit Optimizer Brooks was flagged late in the fourth quarter after making contact with Jared Goff following an 18-yard completion. Tom Brady, in the FOX booth for the game, was clearly unhappy with the decision, saying, “That’s definitely not roughing the passer!” Former NFL Vice President of Officiating Dean Blandino also backed Brady’s criticism. Other calls against defensive tackle Devonte Wyatt for unnecessary roughness and an intentional grounding penalty against Love added to Green Bay’s frustration. The controversy continued to attract attention even after the game ended. The NFL reassigned Moore and his crew from their scheduled primetime assignment for the Philadelphia Eagles vs. Washington Commanders game the following week. Th

item.title: Emiliano Martínez, Valentín Barco, Aarón Anselmino called up by Argentina
item.description: Chelsea goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez during the Premier League match between Everton and Chelsea at Hill Dickinson Stadium in Liverpool, United Kingdom, on October 17, 2026. (Photo by Alfie Cosgrove/News Images/NurPhoto via Getty Images) | NurPhoto via Getty Images There’s an international break after this weekend’s matches, but for a fair few Chelsea boys, there will be no rest. And among those set for national team duty are our trio or Argentinians. Trio? — you might ask. Who all could that be? After all, Enzo Fernández is gone. Alejandro Garnacho is gone. And Emi Martínez has a broken face. Who’s left? Valentín Barco. Sure. Get in the chopper! But joining Barco are indeed Martínez, and, in an even bigger surprise, Aarón Anselmino — man with no actual minutes of competitive senior football yet this season. Maybe Argentina just want their own Estêvão situation. Argentina are playing only a couple friendlies during this break, against Uruguay and Costa Rica, and manager Lionel Scaloni is using this opportunity to check out some fresh faces. Anselmino is one of two players called up with zero senior caps, and one of nine with less than five. (Barco himself is barely above that threshold at seven.) And Emi’s inclusion is hopefully a good sign that is recovery from the fractured jaw he suffered against Everton a few weeks ago is going well. Let’s see that mask! #SelecciónMayor Lista de convocados para los próximos amistosos 🇦🇷 📝 https://t.co/SqoaIewEQR pic.twitter.com/Kxysq82w1A — 🇦🇷 Selección Argentina ⭐⭐⭐ (@Argentina) November 3, 2026

item.title: “The Legacy Continues”: 2Baba Announces New Album ‘Oldest Young Man’
item.description: 2Baba wearing a hooded black pleated drape and sunglasses to announce his studio album, Oldest Young Man. Afrobeats icon 2Baba is officially returning with a full-length body of work, and November 27 is the date to mark in your calendars! The legendary singer and songwriter—formerly known as 2Face Idibia —took to Instagram to announce his upcoming studio album, titled Oldest Young Man. Taking to social media to share the exciting release date, the Afropop veteran captioned his post: The legacy continues. OLDEST YOUNG MAN drops 27.11.26. Timeless music, no expiration date. The announcement marks a huge moment for African music fans. Oldest Young Man is 2Baba’s first studio album in over six years, following his critically acclaimed 2020 project, Warriors , which featured heavyweights like Burna Boy , Wizkid , and Olamide . While he hasn’t dropped a full-length album since then, the Nigerian music pioneer has remained active with steady releases, most recently dropping singles like “ Mental ” in September 2026 and “ Ifesinachi ” earlier in the year. With over two decades at the top of the game—stretching from his days with Plantashun Boiz to solo anthems like “ African Queen “—the legend is set to prove once again why his sound stands the test of time. Oldest Young Man arrives on all streaming platforms on 27 November 2026. 2Baba posing in a draped black pleated outfit and black sunglasses ahead of his upcoming album, Oldest Young Man. *** Photo Credit: 2Baba/Instagram The post “The Legacy Continues”: 2Baba Announces New Album ‘Oldest Young Man’ appeared first on BellaNaija - Showcasing Africa to the world. Read today! .

item.title: Viola Station 107: The more things change
item.description: We’re sticking our necks out a bit with some of these takes. | Jacob King/PA Images via Getty Images So full disclosure: we recorded this before the Sassuolo game . And our collective emotional state was considerably lower. We were, in fact, struggling with our feelings. The podcast reflects that because, in hindsight, we were a little bit grim about Fiorentina’s prospects going forward. That’s apparent in pretty much everything we discussed. What did we discuss? Well, we ran through the recent history, picking our standouts (big dogs, boneheads, et cetera) before considering some tactical and statistical stuff which, in hindsight, probably doesn’t matter as much after Fiorentina got its wait a minute second? That can’t be right, can it? Second win of the season? Okay, yeah, maybe we weren’t entirely wrong in being ruffled. That Relegation Percent-O-Meter still resembles the Doomsday Clock. On the plus side, we got a wonderful McMike milestone, some unexpectedly terse Producer Mike analysis, and Tito completely failing to throw to an advertisement correctly. Thank you as always to ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠ ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠Sport Social Podcast Network⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠ for hosting us and to ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠ ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠Windchime Weather⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠ for the music. And as always, we hope you enjoy listening as much as we enjoyed making this. You could leave a rating and review if you want, but whatever.

item.title: Lightning’s Nikita Kucherov has been on fire since trade request
item.description: Mandatory Credit: Ron Chenoy-Imagn Images Lightning’s Nikita Kucherov has been on fire since trade request appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Nikita Kucherov wants out of the Tampa Bay Lightning , but he still can’t stop going all out for his team. Reports surfaced last Friday that the 33-year-old Kucherov had already asked the Lightning to move him. In the two games since, the two-time Hart Memorial Trophy winner has done nothing on the ice but rack up points. Against the Nashville Predators on Saturday on the road, Kucherov had a hand in three of his team’s goals, as he recorded a trio of assists, albeit in a 5-4 shootout loss to Steven Stamkos and company. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) The Bolts returned to action on Tuesday, and Kucherov was clearly still feeling it, adding two more assists to his total in the 2026-27 NHL season. This time around, his effort did not go for naught, with the Lightning defeating the Detroit Red Wings, 4-2. Kucherov is in a contract year, which means he is on track to become a free agent next summer. However, he also clarified that his trade request is less about money and more about the perceived disrespect he feels from Tampa Bay over its “poor communication.” It remains to be seen how this saga between Kucherov and the Lightning will conclude, but what seems to be clear is that he is not shortchanging the only team he’s played for so far in his NHL career when it comes to his effort and production on the ice. Kucherov and the Lightning improved to 9-3-2 after the win against Detroit. Up next for them is a date with the visiting Chicago Blackhawks on Thursday. Related: Lightning’s Brandon Hagel jabs at Dylan Larkin amid Nikita Kucherov take Related: Lightning’s Nikita Kucherov breaks silence on trade request: ‘Never about the money’

item.title: Ex-Broncos QB Russell Wilson Interviewed for FBS Head Coaching Job
item.description: Denver Broncos head coach Russell Wilson. Getty Former Denver Broncos quarterback Russell Wilson could be headed for a major career shift less than one year after the end of his NFL career. “Former Super Bowl champion quarterback Russell Wilson interviewed Tuesday for the head coaching job at NC State, ” ESPN’s Adam Schefter wrote on Tuesday night. “Wilson, 38, joins Philip Rivers as former NC State and NFL quarterbacks who are now prominent candidates for the Wolfpack job. NC State fired Dave Doeren as head coach on Oct. 24. Wilson played at NC State from 2008 to 2010 before transferring to Wisconsin in 2011. After being taken by Seattle in the third round of the 2012 NFL draft, he went on to play 14 seasons in the NFL, leading the Seahawks to their first Super Bowl championship in the 2013 season.” Wilson, a 10-time NFL All-Pro, retired in June and has been working for CBS Sports as an analyst this fall. “Interesting that Russell Wilson and Philip Rivers are contenders,” NFL reporter Ed Werder wrote on his official X account on Tuesday. Wilson spent his first 10 seasons with the Seattle Seahawks , where he won one Super Bowl and played in another before a blockbuster trade to the Broncos before the 2022 season. He lasted 2 seasons in Denver before spending one season each with the Pittsburgh Steelers and New York Giants . Broncos’ Wilson Trade One of NFL’s All-Time Worst Bleacher Report’s Kristopher Knox called the Broncos’ trade with the Seahawks for Wilson “Worst NFL Trade of the Last 10 Years” for the franchise. By releasing Wilson in April 2024, the Broncos were forced to take an NFL-record $85 million dead cap hit spread across the 2024 and 2025 seasons. “The Denver Broncos’ ill-fated 2022 trade for Russell Wilson has largely been overshadowed by the disastrous deal Cleveland made for Deshaun Watson in the same offseason,” Knox wrote. “However, that doesn’t mean that Denver’s deal was a good one. In fact, the Wilson trade might be considered the worst of the last decade if not for the Watson debacle. The Broncos coughed up two first-round picks, two second-round picks, a fifth-round pick, quarterback Drew Lock , defensive lineman Shelby Harris and tight end Noah Fant to acquire Wilson and a fourth-round pick. The Broncos then signed Wilson to an extension worth $242.6 million over five years with $161 million guaranteed.” Russell Wilson, Sean Payton Butted Heads in 2023 The writing was on the wall for Wilson once Nathaniel Hackett was fired after one season as Denver’s head coach in 2022 and replaced with former New Orleans Saints head coach and Super Bowl champion Sean Payton. Wilson and Payton famously butted heads, but the bottom line was that Wilson went 11-19 over 2 seasons in Denver before he was released. Wilson rejuvenated his career somewhat in 2024 with the Pittsburgh Steelers on a 1-year, $1.2 million contract. NC State fired Dave Doeren as head coach on Oct. 24. Wilson played at NC State from 2008 to 2010 before transferring to Wisconsin in 2011. After being taken by Seattle in the third round of the 2012 NFL draft, he went on to play 14 seasons in the NFL, leading the Seahawks to their first Super Bowl championship in the 2013 season.” Wilson, a 10-time NFL All-Pro, retired in June and has been working for CBS Sports as an analyst this fall. “Interesting that Russell Wilson and Philip Rivers are contenders,” NFL reporter Ed Werder wrote on his official X account on Tuesday. Wilson spent his first 10 seasons with the Seattle Seahawks , where he won one Super Bowl and played in another before a blockbuster trade to the Broncos before the 2022 season. He lasted 2 seasons in Denver before spending one season each with the Pittsburgh Steelers and New York Giants . Broncos’ Wilson Trade One of NFL’s All-Time Worst Bleacher Report’s Kristopher Knox called the Broncos’ trade with the Seahawks for Wilson “Worst NFL Trade of the Last 10 Years” for the franchise. By releasing Wilson in April 2024, the Broncos were forced to take an NFL-record $85 million dead cap hit spread across the 2024 and 2025 seasons. “The Denver Broncos’ ill-fated 2022 trade for Russell Wilson has largely been overshadowed by the disastrous deal Cleveland made for Deshaun Watson in the same offseason,” Knox wrote. “However, that doesn’t mean that Denver’s deal was a good one. In fact, the Wilson trade might be considered the worst of the last decade if not for the Watson debacle. The Broncos coughed up two first-round picks, two second-round picks, a fifth-round pick, quarterback Drew Lock , defensive lineman Shelby Harris and tight end Noah Fant to acquire Wilson and a fourth-round pick. The Broncos then signed Wilson to an extension worth $242.6 million over five years with $161 million guaranteed.” Russell Wilson, Sean Payton Butted Heads in 2023 The writing was on the wall for Wilson once Nathaniel Hackett was fired after one season as Denver’s head coach in 2022 and replaced with former New Orleans Saints head coach and Super Bowl champion Sean Payton. Wilson and Payton famously butted heads, but the bottom line was that Wilson went 11-19 over 2 seasons in Denver before he was released. Wilson rejuvenated his career somewhat in 2024 with the Pittsburgh Steelers on a 1-year, $1.2 million contract. After missing the first 6 games of the season due to injury — Justin Fields started in his place — Wilson returned to go 6-5 for the Steelers, who made the AFC Playoffs before losing to the Baltimore Ravens in the AFC Wild Card Round, with Wilson going 20-of-29 passing for 270 yards, two touchdowns, and zero interceptions. Wilson signed a 1-year, $10.5 million contract with the New York Giants on March 27 — just one month before they selected Ole Miss quarterback Jaxson Dart in the first round of the 2025 NFL draft . item.title: Naira rises, now N1,374/$ in parallel market
item.description: …As interbank turnover rises 445% By Elizabeth Adegbesan The Naira yesterday appreciated to N1,374 per dollar from N1,377 in the parallel market on Monday. But the naira depreciated to N1,347.75 per dollar in the Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market, NFEM. Data from the Central Bank of Nigeria, CBN, showed that the indicative exchange rate for the official market rose slightly to N1,347.75 per dollar from N1,346.01 per dollar on Monday, indicating N1.74 depreciation for the naira. Consequently, the margin between the parallel and official markets narrowed to N26.25 per dollar from N30.99 per dollar on Monday. The value of interbank turnover in NFEM increased sharply by 445.6 percent to $118.95 billion from $21.8 billion on Monday. item.title: Police rescue Nigerian woman sold for N770,000 in Mali
item.description: By Kingsley Omonobi The Nigeria Police Force has rescued a 21-year-old Nigerian woman trafficked to Mali and forced into prostitution, arresting three suspected members of an international human trafficking syndicate. The operation was carried out by operatives of the Special Tactical Squad, Force Intelligence Department (STS-FID), following an intelligence-led investigation into the trafficking network. The development was disclosed during a press briefing by ACP Victor Ogbeide Godfrey, who coordinated the operation. He said the suspects were arrested between October 1 and 27, 2026. The suspects were identified as Daniel Aondofa, 26; Orgba Solomon, 28, also known as Terry; and ThankGod Ocho, 25. All three are indigenes of Benue State, while Solomon was identified as the alleged leader of the syndicate. The police said the victim, Patience Darius, from Akwanga, Nasarawa State, was lured by Solomon with promises of lucrative employment opportunities abroad. According to the police, she was taken to Lagos on September 26 before being moved through illegal border routes into the Benin Republic and subsequently transported to gold-mining camps in Mali, where women were allegedly forced into prostitution. Solomon reportedly confiscated her mobile phone and travel documents before taking her out of Nigeria, cutting off communication with her family and friends. Upon arrival in Mali, she was allegedly handed over to two individuals identified as Mohammed and Marian, also known as Riana, before being sold for 420,000 CFA francs, equivalent to approximately N770,000. Recounting her ordeal, the victim said she was severely beaten for refusing to engage in prostitution and subsequently taken to a shrine, where she was forced to take a blood oath. The police report quoted her as saying that when she refused to engage in prostitution, she was “beaten blue and black” and taken to a shrine, where she was forced to take a blood oath before being compelled into prostitution. The Force said the investigation began after the victim’s sister lodged a complaint, prompting operatives to deploy digital intelligence to track the trafficking network. It said Solomon was arrested after returning to Nigeria to recruit more women for trafficking to Senegal and Mali, while the two other suspects were also apprehended. The suspects reportedly confessed to their involvement in the crime and provided information that facilitated the victim’s rescue from Mali. The police further disclosed that Darius alleged that about 42 Nigerian women were being held in a makeshift camp within a gold-mining settlement in Mali, where they were subjected to forced prostitution and slave-like conditions. According to the victim, the women were kept under strict surveillance, making escape almost impossible. item.title: ADC’s struggle to campaign
item.description: There was an air of uncertainty on Tuesday over whether the flag-off of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential campaign in Sokoto State scheduled for Wednesday (today) would be held as planned. Daily Trust gathered that, as of Tuesday evening, the party was still struggling to secure a venue for the event, mobilise supporters, and make other basic logistical arrangements for the rally. Our correspondents report that the event was initially scheduled for Saturday, October 31, but was shifted to Wednesday due to the alleged takeover of hotel bookings by the state government, which has denied the claim. It was learnt that due to problems of logistics, some ADC leaders in the state offered their homes and guest houses to accommodate party leaders and other dignitaries arriving for the party’s presidential campaign flag-off. Benue APC: Rival Tinubu campaign lists deepen factional rift Can the North afford to continue without its own ‘Parapo’? Some party leaders confirmed this in separate interviews with our correspondents, saying they resorted to providing private accommodation after failing to secure hotel rooms for their guests. Spokesman for the ADC governorship candidate in Sokoto State, Aminu Abubakar, said the party was yet to secure hotel accommodation, prompting members to volunteer their residences and guest houses. “Some of them have offered their homes, while others have provided their guest houses to accommodate our visitors. That is where we are putting them up,” he said. Another party chieftain, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said some prominent party leaders had already arrived in Sokoto ahead of the event. He said they include the party’s National Secretary and former Osun State Governor, Rauf Aregbesola; Senator Dino Melaye; and the party’s governorship candidate in Kaduna State, Isa Ashiru Kudan. item.dc:creator: Our Reporters
item.content:encoded: There was an air of uncertainty on Tuesday over whether the flag-off of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential campaign in Sokoto State scheduled for Wednesday (today) would be held as planned. Daily Trust gathered that, as of Tuesday evening, the party was still struggling to secure a venue for the event, mobilise supporters, and make other basic logistical arrangements for the rally. Our correspondents report that the event was initially scheduled for Saturday, October 31, but was shifted to Wednesday due to the alleged takeover of hotel bookings by the state government, which has denied the claim. It was learnt that due to problems of logistics, some ADC leaders in the state offered their homes and guest houses to accommodate party leaders and other dignitaries arriving for the party’s presidential campaign flag-off. Benue APC: Rival Tinubu campaign lists deepen factional rift Can the North afford to continue without its own ‘Parapo’? Some party leaders confirmed this in separate interviews with our correspondents, saying they resorted to providing private accommodation after failing to secure hotel rooms for their guests. Spokesman for the ADC governorship candidate in Sokoto State, Aminu Abubakar, said the party was yet to secure hotel accommodation, prompting members to volunteer their residences and guest houses. “Some of them have offered their homes, while others have provided their guest houses to accommodate our visitors. That is where we are putting them up,” he said. Another party chieftain, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said some prominent party leaders had already arrived in Sokoto ahead of the event. He said they include the party’s National Secretary and former Osun State Governor, Rauf Aregbesola; Senator Dino Melaye; and the party’s governorship candidate in Kaduna State, Isa Ashiru Kudan. The source added that more party leaders and dignitaries were expected to arrive Tuesday night or early Wednesday. However, the party was yet to officially announce the exact venue of the rally as of the time of filing this report. Supporters of the ADC in Sokoto yesterday An unverified source claimed that the event would take place at the Trade Fair Complex, while another source said it would be held at the party’s office premises along Ahmadu Bello Way, which was recently sealed by the state government. A source familiar with the arrangement alleged that the party had been asked to pay N20 million for the use of the Trade Fair Complex. According to the source, the party had agreed to the payment and requested the account details to enable it to transfer the money, but the details had yet to be provided. Director-General of the ADC Governorship Campaign Council, Bello Muhammad Goronyo, when contacted for clarification on the arrival of party leaders and the venue of the event declined to comment, saying he was not aware of the arrival of the guests or where the presidential campaign flag-off would take place. Meanwhile, another source said the disagreement surrounding the sealing of the party’s office had been resolved and that renovation work was carried out at the facility on Monday night. We’re going ahead with rally – Sokoto ADC Despite the challenges, the ADC said it had concluded arrangements for its campaign flag-off. The state Vice-Chairman of the party, Bello Isyaku Keegan, said the party had made transportation arrangements and other materials for supporters expected to attend the rally from various local government areas. He said the party was optimistic that the event would be successful, adding that all arrangements had been concluded. Keegan, however, declined to disclose the venue of the rally, citing fears of possible intimidation by the state government. He said the party had arranged accommodation for some supporters within the Sokoto metropolis, while others had secured rooms in Birnin Kebbi to enable them to arrive early for the event. “We have completed our preparations and distributed transport money and materials to our members coming from different local government areas. We expect tomorrow (today) to be wonderful for us,” he said. The media aide to the party’s governorship candidate, Aminu Abdullahi Abubakar, said meetings had been ongoing since Tuesday morning, while guests and other party supporters had continued to arrive in the state. He said some residents had offered their personal houses and lodges to accommodate the visitors, adding that about six aircraft had arrived with guests from the Presidential Campaign Council (PCC) and other states. Abubakar said he could not confirm the total number of guests who had arrived as of the time of the interview but identified the Deputy Director-General, Administration of the PCC and former minister who is from the state, Yusuf Suleiman, as among the early arrivals. On the controversy surrounding the use of the venue, he said former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar had written to the relevant authorities on Monday, requesting approval for the rally venue, but the party had yet to receive an acknowledgement as of Tuesday evening. He alleged that after submitting the letter, the authorities closed the office, although it was reopened on Tuesday morning. Abubakar further said the party was later informed that five Hilux vehicles conveying security operatives had been deployed to prevent the use of the venue after party members were seen entering the office earlier in the day. He said the security vehicles were stationed around the campaign council office, apparently to seal the premises. According to him, the latest letter was the second request submitted by the party after Sokoto was selected as the venue for the campaign flag-off. He said the first request was rejected, prompting Senator Aminu Waziri Tambuwal to submit another letter on Monday. In the letter, Atiku reportedly appealed to the authorities to reconsider their position and allow the party to use the venue, citing its constitutional right to political participation. ADC secretariat in Sokoto Efforts to get reactions from the Sokoto State Government and the All Progressives Congress (APC) were unsuccessful, as the Commissioner for Information, Sambo Danchadi; the Governor’s Director-General of Media and Publicity, Abubakar Bawa; and the state APC Chairman, Haruna Adiya, could not be reached by phone as of the time of filing this report. Meanwhile, the ADC Secretary in Tangaza Local Government Area, Yahuza Mode Tangaza, said members from several local government areas had concluded plans to attend the rally. He said supporters from Tangaza, Gudu, Binji, Kware, Gwadabawa, Illela and Gada would converge on a designated point before proceeding together to the venue. Tangaza said the party had instructed its members to conduct themselves peacefully and avoid carrying weapons or engaging in any act capable of breaching public order. “We have been told not to do anything against the law. If anything happens to us, we should report to security agencies and provide evidence,” he said. He added that members had also been warned against pasting posters or displaying banners, which he said could expose them to possible attacks. Another party chieftain, Alhaji Cika Mairago, who contested the party’s primary election but did not emerge victorious, said members were fully prepared to receive the presidential candidate. He said the party had no reason to fear as long as its members conducted themselves within the law. “We are used to opposition politics and, by God’s grace, we will conduct our politics properly. We believe that as long as you obey the law, nobody should deny you justice, unless those involved are acting out of personal interest,” he said. We’ll ensure peaceful rally – police However, the Sokoto State Police Command said it had deployed personnel across the state and gathered intelligence to ensure a peaceful rally. item.title: Before the Dawn in America’s Heartland
item.description: Earth Observatory Science Earth Observatory Before the Dawn in America’s… Earth Earth Observatory Image of the Day EO Explorer Topics All Topics Atmosphere Land Heat & Radiation Life on Earth Human Dimensions Natural Events Oceans Remote Sensing Technology Snow & Ice Water More Content Collections Global Maps World of Change Articles Earth Matters Blog Blue Marble: Next Generation EO Kids Mission: Biomes About About Us Subscribe 🛜 RSS Contact Us Search October 18, 2026 The predawn hours brought clear skies over much of the eastern United States on October 18, 2026. An astronaut aboard the International Space Station seized the opportunity to capture this wide-angle photo at 4:54 a.m. Central Daylight Time (09:54 Universal Time), with illuminated cities large and small arrayed across the darkened landscape. The U.S. Midwest’s largest metropolitan areas , such as Chicago, Illinois, and Detroit, Michigan, stand out as some of the brightest features. Mid-sized cities—including Indianapolis, Indiana; Cincinnati, Ohio; and Louisville, Kentucky—and their interconnections along state and interstate highways also shine brightly. Above the web of nighttime lights and Earth’s lower atmosphere, a diffuse layer of green and orange is visible along the horizon to the left. This band of light is airglow , produced when sunlight strikes atoms and molecules in the upper atmosphere and causes them to eject photons . To the right, light from the Sun arcs across the horizon; sunrise was about an hour away on the East Coast and about two hours away in Chicago. Astronaut photos and other remote sensing observations of nighttime lights are scientifically valuable for tracking changes in the built environment. For example, Chicago’s lightscape appears a homogeneous pale yellow in the wide view above. But in detailed photos, like the one below, a range of colors stemming from different types of lighting is discernible. Using NASA’s extensive Gateway to Astronaut Photography of Earth archive, researchers have developed a method for distinguishing lighting types within the pixels of nighttime photos. Systematically quantifying urban lights’ brightness, color, and extent can provide insight into how cities grow and evolve . March 1, 2024 Satellite sensors also observe changes to lighting. In particular, NASA’s Black Marble nighttime lights product suite uses satellite observations to produce science-quality records of nighttime lights across the globe at daily, monthly, and yearly time scales. In the eastern U.S., scientists have used these data to track everything from power outages and restoration following major storms to lighting changes associated with new infrastructure to transitions to LED lighting from older forms. Astronaut photograph ISS075-E-226709 was acquired on October 18, 2026, with a Nikon Z9 digital camera using a focal length of 14 millimeters, and photograph ISS070-E-105097 was acquired on March 1, 2024, with a Nikon D5 digital camera using a focal length of 400 millimeters. They are provided by the ISS Crew Earth Observations Facility and the Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit at NASA Johnson Space Center. The images were taken by members of the Expedition 75 and Expedition 70 crews, respectively. The images have been cropped and enhanced to improve contrast, and lens artifacts have been removed. The International Space Station Program supports the laboratory as part of the ISS National Lab to help astronauts take pictures of Earth that will be of the greatest value to scientists and the public, and to make those images freely available on the internet. Additional images taken by astronauts and cosmonauts can be viewed at the NASA/JSC Gateway to Astronaut Photography of Earth . Story by Lindsey Doermann. item.title: AMD on track to overtake Intel as biggest x86 outfit
item.description: AMD has predicted it will win more revenue than Intel in its next quarter, potentially marking the first time it becomes the dominant vendor whose main product is x86 processors. The house of Zen on Tuesday announced its Q3 2026 results, which saw it grow revenue 45 percent year-over-year to $13.4 billion. The company’s Data Center segment won $8.5 billion of revenue, up 97 percent year-over-year. Sales of silicon in AMD’s client and gaming segment slid eight percent to $3.7 billion, a worse fall than the five percent fall that helped to sink Intel’s share price . Intel, AMD’s great rival in the x86 market, offered revenue guidance of $15 billion to $16 billion for its next quarter, which would represent almost no growth. AMD, by contrast, told investors it expects around $17 billion of revenue next quarter. CEO Lisa Su predicted even better days are ahead. “We think 2027 is going to be a very strong momentum year for both the CPU business as well as the data center AI business,” she said on the company’s earnings call. “We have said the overall company will grow greater than 80 percent, and for the data center CPU business, we will about double, and for the data center AI business, it will significantly more than double.” Su said AMD is confident its supply chain can meet that demand. “We have worked across our supply chain to secure the wafers, substrates, advanced packaging, memory, and other key components needed to support much higher growth next year,” she said. “We are also deepening our collaboration with our supply chain partners and investing alongside them to secure the long-term capacity our growth will require.” The CEO added that AMD has “strong confidence in our ability to sustain exceptional revenue growth for years to come, with earnings growing even faster.” If those predictions are correct, AMD will likely accelerate away from Intel to become the leading provider of x86 processors after years of challenging Chipzilla's lead. Intel would still have higher overall revenue, due to its foundry operations, but in terms of revenue earned from selling chips, AMD would become the market leader. AMD is arguably already the server CPU technology leader, and while it is second to Nvidia in the GPU market has trounced Intel. Even AMD's declining client and gaming revenue has an upside because it was the gaming part of the portfolio that created the problem. PC chip sales rose seven percent year-over-year to $2.9 billion. Su said strong sales of Ryzen mobile processors drove that growth. “Commercial is becoming a larger part of our client business as large enterprises adopt Ryzen PRO PCs across their employee base,” she said, pointing to strong adoption at the world’s largest banks, automotive companies, and healthcare concerns. Big corporate buyers are often a source of bigger profits and/or steadier revenue, so AMD looks to be taking the cream off the top of the PC market rather than scrounging for SMB and retail scraps. Investors liked w

item.content:encoded: AMD has predicted it will win more revenue than Intel in its next quarter, potentially marking the first time it becomes the dominant vendor whose main product is x86 processors. The house of Zen on Tuesday announced its Q3 2026 results, which saw it grow revenue 45 percent year-over-year to $13.4 billion. The company’s Data Center segment won $8.5 billion of revenue, up 97 percent year-over-year. Sales of silicon in AMD’s client and gaming segment slid eight percent to $3.7 billion, a worse fall than the five percent fall that helped to sink Intel’s share price . Intel, AMD’s great rival in the x86 market, offered revenue guidance of $15 billion to $16 billion for its next quarter, which would represent almost no growth. AMD, by contrast, told investors it expects around $17 billion of revenue next quarter. CEO Lisa Su predicted even better days are ahead. “We think 2027 is going to be a very strong momentum year for both the CPU business as well as the data center AI business,” she said on the company’s earnings call. “We have said the overall company will grow greater than 80 percent, and for the data center CPU business, we will about double, and for the data center AI business, it will significantly more than double.” Su said AMD is confident its supply chain can meet that demand. “We have worked across our supply chain to secure the wafers, substrates, advanced packaging, memory, and other key components needed to support much higher growth next year,” she said. “We are also deepening our collaboration with our supply chain partners and investing alongside them to secure the long-term capacity our growth will require.” The CEO added that AMD has “strong confidence in our ability to sustain exceptional revenue growth for years to come, with earnings growing even faster.” If those predictions are correct, AMD will likely accelerate away from Intel to become the leading provider of x86 processors after years of challenging Chipzilla's lead. Intel would still have higher overall revenue, due to its foundry operations, but in terms of revenue earned from selling chips, AMD would become the market leader. AMD is arguably already the server CPU technology leader, and while it is second to Nvidia in the GPU market has trounced Intel. Even AMD's declining client and gaming revenue has an upside because it was the gaming part of the portfolio that created the problem. PC chip sales rose seven percent year-over-year to $2.9 billion. Su said strong sales of Ryzen mobile processors drove that growth. “Commercial is becoming a larger part of our client business as large enterprises adopt Ryzen PRO PCs across their employee base,” she said, pointing to strong adoption at the world’s largest banks, automotive companies, and healthcare concerns. Big corporate buyers are often a source of bigger profits and/or steadier revenue, so AMD looks to be taking the cream off the top of the PC market rather than scrounging for SMB and retail scraps. Investors liked what they heard, sending AMD’s share price up by around five percent in after hours trading. ®

item.title: All the news about The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake
item.description: Ahead of the release of Rockstar Games’ Grand Theft Auto VI , Nintendo is launching its own fall juggernaut: a Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time . The remake, which is releasing 28 years after the launch of the original version on Nintendo 64, has a much more realistic visual style and some modern improvements like a jump button, a way to sprint, full voice acting, and a “Threads of Time” feature that helps you keep track of your progress. But while the game has a new coat of paint, it appears many elements will still remain faithful to the classic N64 release. Nintendo has also launched a special version of the Switch 2 and Switch 2 Pro Controller with Triforce imagery to celebrate the game. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is scheduled to release on November 5th. You can follow along with all of our coverage of the game right here. Keep on rolling. A link to the past. There’s one week left to preorder the Ocarina of Time remake for $10 off Here’s Nintendo’s overview trailer for the Ocarina of Time remake. The Ocarina of Time remake feels remarkably modern — and surprisingly terrifying Hori’s electronic Ocarina of Time requires no musical talent. item.description: Maika Monroe has built a career as a modern scream queen. After a breakout 2014, when she starred in both It Follows and The Guest , she became a key figure in horror, continuing to revisit the genre in everything from Longlegs to Victorian Psycho . This year, both It Follows and The Guest have been a part of the horror conversation: It Follows just wrapped a sequel, wonderfully titled They Follow , while The Guest just received a quasi-sequel with Onslaught , which director Adam Wingard set in the same continuity as his previous 2014 film.

item.title: Aussie Adobe assailant Canva announces layoffs in re-org affecting 22% of staff
item.description: Australian design software maker Canva is restructuring, with 1,271 employees, or 22 percent of its workforce, facing layoffs, changes to their roles, or requests to relocate. The company, which has become a challenger to Adobe, announced the news by sharing a message that CEO Melanie Perkins sent to staff on Wednesday. That missive, titled “An important update on our team,” doesn’t mention AI but does state “New technology is transforming what people can create, how they create it, and what they expect from the products they use.” Perkins observed that Canva’s rate of growth recently slowed for the first time in a decade and shared her view that continued success won’t happen without change. “After exploring a wide range of alternatives, I've come to the difficult conclusion that small changes won’t be enough,” she wrote. “To set ourselves up for the next decade, we need to refound Canva, getting back to our roots of small, empowered teams with the freedom to make decisions, take ownership and focus on what matters most for our community.” The CEO did not say how many jobs would go, but argued the changes are necessary because the company has become inefficient. The changes will therefore see Canva combine its product, growth and platform teams into a single “Product Org,” which Perkins says means “changing the way we work to provide clearer ownership, greater autonomy and flexibility to tackle our most important goals.” She characterized the changes as “simplifying layers, consolidating overlapping responsibilities, and ensuring teams have the right mix of skills and experience for the chapter ahead.” The CEO three times described herself as “deeply sorry” for the changes. Affected staff will receive a calendar invite for an optional individual meeting with a senior leader. Remaining staff get to attend two rounds of meetings next week – one company-wide affair and another with their reorganized teams. Another of Perkins’ decisions will see Canva move more of its product teams to its headquarters in Sydney, Australia. The company will ask some staff to relocate and has promised “comprehensive support” to make that happen. Departing staff can keep their company-issued MacBooks and will receive at least six months' pay, a year of health insurance, plus various forms of support to find a new gig including a one-year membership of LinkedIn Premium. Perkins’ post does not cite financial pressures as a reason for the layoffs. Canva is privately held and does not face the same financial disclosure requirements as a listed business, but last year revealed it had 260 million monthly users and revenue of $3.5 billion. Execs have previously claimed the company is profitable on a free-cash-flow basis. Canva and Atlassian are among Australia’s most successful and celebrated technology businesses. Both have now announced job cuts this year. ®
